reason: The final supremum inference omits the allowed zero-domain case. The H-CB datum does not require S_P to be nonzero (indeed node 1.1.1 explicitly treats S_P=0). If S_P=0, then M_n tensor S_P=0 and the set {Z: ||Z||=1} is empty, so sup_{||Z||=1} ||h_n(Z)|| and the claimed identity sup_{||Z||=1}||h_n(Z)||^2=b_n^2 are not justified merely from b_n<infinity and nonnegativity. The scalar conclusion is true in that case because b_n=0, but the stated inference needs an explicit zero-space case split or must take the supremum over the closed unit ball ||Z||<=1 (which contains 0).
